metadata.title: Identity Authentication

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional capability for verifying that an entity claiming an identity is the legitimate holder of that identity.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Authentication services independent of vendor or implementation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Centralized and federated authentication services with institutional governance.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Credential data used to perform authentication.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Authentication event data generated during identity verification.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Authentication mechanisms, factors, step-up, and session establishment align with SP 800-63A requirements for authentication assurance without binding identities to a fixed AAL.

metadata.remarks:
Identity Authentication defines the capability to verify that an entity claiming an identity is the legitimate holder of that identity at the time of access. This pattern establishes proof of identity but does not determine authorization or entitlements.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance related to authentication. Identity semantics are defined in Identity Core; authentication provides time‑bound proof of possession or control.

components.title: Authentication Events
components.description: Generation and handling of authentication attempts and outcomes, including success, failure, and contextual metadata.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Removal or manipulation of evidence to evade detection of authentication abuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authentication event logging enables accountability and forensic analysis.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure sufficient detail in authentication logs.

components.title: Authentication Context
components.description: Contextual signals used during authentication such as device posture, location, time, and risk indicators.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Modification or spoofing of contextual signals to bypass authentication policy.

components.title: Step‑Up Authentication
components.description: Dynamic strengthening of authentication assurance in response to elevated risk or sensitivity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Additional authentication factors applied when risk increases.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cryptographic and multi-factor mechanisms for high-risk access.

components.title: Session Establishment
components.description: Binding successful authentication events to controlled, time‑bounded access sessions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Session hijacking or reuse after successful authentication.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Secure creation and management of authenticated sessions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Session use aligns with account lifecycle management.
